extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media representatives requesting embargoed JAMA Network content
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for media access to embargoed JAMA Network content, including the requirement to agree to embargo terms and the standard embargo lift times for JAMA and JAMA Network journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permission conditional on honoring embargoes
rubrics_metrics.description: Permission to access embargoed material presented here is granted in exchange for your agreement to honor all The JAMA Network journals’ embargoes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media must agree to the embargo terms before being granted access to embargoed content. Access is contingent on this agreement; do not assume permission to use or publish content before the embargo lifts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Posting schedule for new embargoed content
rubrics_metrics.description: New embargoed content is posted on various days of the week.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is not a single fixed day for all embargoed postings; media should monitor the site or journal communications for when specific items are posted and note that posting days vary by content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard embargo lift time for JAMA content
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless otherwise specified, JAMA content is embargoed until Tuesday at 11 a.m. Eastern time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assume JAMA articles remain under embargo until the specified Tuesday 11 a.m. ET unless an item explicitly states a different embargo lift time. Do not publish or report on the content before this time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard embargo lift time for JAMA Network journals
rubrics_metrics.description: Content from the JAMA Network journals is embargoed until 11 a.m. Eastern time on various days of the week, depending on the journal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different journals within the JAMA Network may have different embargo days, but the common lift time is 11 a.m. ET on the journal's assigned day. Verify the journal-specific embargo day for each item before publishing.
